supportingSources.label: Bob's Guide for the saved Gottlieb edition
PinballCards The Incredible Hulk rules card

strategy.summary: Send the ball to the four top lanes and collect the lit multiplier, preferably 5x. Complete 1-2-3 to light the spinner. Build base bonus to 20,000, then guide the ball into either kicker for a 100,000 Bonus Collect.

quickInfo.name: Lit Bonus X lane
quickInfo.summary: A lit top lane awards its displayed multiplier directly and can jump from 1x to 5x.
Unlight all three numbered targets to light the spinner for the ball and the right lane once.

quickInfo.name: Lit Spinner
quickInfo.summary: After 1-2-3, each spin scores 1,000 and adds one base-bonus advance for the current ball.

quickInfo.name: Bonus Collect
quickInfo.summary: At 20,000 base bonus, either kicker collects the multiplied bonus, resets base bonus, and preserves Bonus X.

quickInfo.name: A-B-C
quickInfo.summary: Use both kickers once and complete the seven-bank to light inlane Specials for the current ball.

steps.text: Before the plunge, read which top lane has a lit multiplier. Plunge for the highest reachable value.
modeNotes: Lit Bonus X lane: A lit top lane awards its displayed 2x, 3x, 4x, or 5x directly. You do not need lower values first.
Ten-point switches rotate the lit lane. After a collect, only higher multiplier lanes can light.

steps.text: Cradle the first controllable ball. Test the right-flipper spinner shot and its reject.
Use the spinner or a bank shot from the upper-right targets to return the ball to the top lanes.
Repeat until Bonus X reaches 5x, or stop at the best controlled value.
Hit lit 1, 2, and 3 targets until all three become unlit.
modeNotes: 1-2-3: A lit target scores 5,000 and one bonus advance, then becomes unlit. An unlit target scores 500 and one advance.
Completion lights the spinner for the rest of the ball and lights the right side lane once.

steps.text: Shoot the lit spinner to build base bonus toward 20,000.
modeNotes: Lit Spinner: Each spin scores 1,000 and adds one bonus advance. An unlit spin scores 100.

steps.text: When base bonus reaches 20,000, guide a descending ball into either center-side kicker.
modeNotes: Bonus Collect: Both kicker lanes light at maximum base bonus. A kicker scores base bonus with Bonus X, resets base bonus, and preserves Bonus X.
The kickers replace normal slingshots. They accept balls only from above, so no lower flipper has a direct collect shot.

steps.text: After the kicker returns the ball upfield, rebuild base bonus with the lit spinner and lanes.
Repeat the kicker collect while the feed remains controlled. All bonus progress resets after the ball.

fallback.title: Recovery: Lit spinner and any-multiplier collect
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the lit top lane is hard to reach or repeated upper feeds become unsafe.

steps.text: Complete lit 1, 2, and 3 targets.
Confirm that the spinner lights for the current ball.
Shoot the spinner firmly from the right flipper.
Use each spin to build base bonus to 20,000.
Accept the current Bonus X. Do not force another top-lane attempt.
Guide a descending ball into either lit kicker.
Collect the multiplied bonus and rebuild base bonus.

alternatives.title: Position play: 1-2-3 Extra Ball
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this when the middle-right lane feed is controlled and Extra Ball has tournament value.

steps.text: Unlight the lit 1, 2, and 3 targets.
modeNotes: Extra Ball: A 1-2-3 completion lights the right side lane once. The lit lane scores 10,000 and awards a replay ball.

steps.text: Guide the ball into the middle-right lane from above when possible.
A lit entry scores 10,000, one bonus advance, and Extra Ball.
An unlit entry scores 500 and one bonus advance.
The lane lights only once per ball.

alternatives.title: A-B-C Special route
alternatives.when: Use this only when replay Specials score and both kicker entries are predictable.

steps.text: Use each center-side kicker once to collect A and B.
modeNotes: A-B-C: The first left and right kicker uses collect A and B. Completing the seven-bank collects C.
An unused letter kicker scores 5,000 and one bonus advance. Later entries score 500 and one advance before Bonus Collect lights.

steps.text: Hit each of the seven drop targets.
Each target scores 3,000 and one bonus advance.
The full bank adds 5,000, collects C, and resets.
After A-B-C, roll through either lit inlane for Special.
modeNotes: Special: Both inlanes light after A-B-C. An inlane collect lights the same-side outlane for another Special.

steps.text: Ignore this route when replay awards have no tournament value.

alternatives.title: Seven-bank top-feed route
alternatives.when: Use this when bank shots reach the top more safely than the spinner.

steps.text: Cradle on the left flipper.
Bank the ball from the upper-right targets toward the four top lanes.
Collect the lit Bonus X lane when the feed reaches it.
Let incidental drop hits add base bonus.
After 5x, use bank shots only when more base bonus is needed.
Stop after a center-directed target rebound.
Collect the lit 5x top lane.
Complete 1-2-3 to light the spinner.
Use the spinner to build base bonus to 20,000.
Guide the ball into either lit kicker.
Collect 100,000 and preserve 5x.
Rebuild base bonus and repeat the collect.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Read the lit multiplier before the ball reaches the four lanes. Use a small legal nudge toward that lane.

techniques.name: Spinner dribble collect
techniques.instruction: Shoot the spinner firmly. When a reject descends slowly, guide it into the left kicker instead of forcing another shot.

techniques.name: Upper-right bank feed
techniques.instruction: From the left flipper, bank the ball from the upper-right targets toward the top lanes.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Begin a legal nudge before the ball reaches a kicker mouth. Let the passive rubber deflect the ball into the lane.

cautions.issue: Spinner shots can reject from the upper rubber or miss the top lanes at high speed.
cautions.response: Test one firm shot. Prepare both flippers when the ball returns outside the four lanes.

cautions.issue: A ball can rattle out of either kicker and drain through the center.
cautions.response: Nudge before the ball settles. Keep both flippers ready until the kicker fires.

cautions.issue: The inlane-outlane divider begins below the entry point.
cautions.response: Do not assume a clean entry reaches the inlane. Use an early legal nudge at the split.

cautions.issue: All standup and drop-target shots can rebound toward a drain.
cautions.response: Complete only needed targets. Stop direct target shots after the spinner and 5x are ready.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm original System 1 hardware, not a replacement rules board.
Test top lanes, spinner, both kickers, and Bonus Collect lamps.
strategy.simpleOverview: The Incredible Hulk is a multiplier-and-bonus-collect game. Send the ball through the lit top-lane multiplier, hit the numbered 1-2-3 targets until the spinner lights, use spinner spins to raise base bonus, then guide the ball into either kicker for the collect.
strategy.overview: The Incredible Hulk is a multiplier-and-bonus-collect game. Reach the best controlled multiplier, hit lit 1-2-3 targets until they go dark, then use the spinner to raise base bonus to 20,000. Guide the ball into either kicker, preserve Bonus X, and repeat the build and collect.
machineSetup: Confirm original System 1 hardware, not a replacement rules board.
Test top lanes, spinner, both kickers, and Bonus Collect lamps.
